stem: With bootstrap=True and all features available at each split, which stated mechanism still gives different training rows to different forest trees?

options.text: Using one identical bootstrap row sample for all trees merely because the forest has a fixed seed.
Randomly breaking equal-gain feature ties after every tree receives exactly the same row sample.
Sampling training rows with replacement for each tree.
Choosing one fixed feature subset for every tree.
